name: Roetgen (Germany)
description: Hanging banner of red with a white winged creature in the upper part and two white pales in the lower part, the figures of the municipal arms of Roetgen.
history: Municipal flag of Roetgen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: winged creature from the municipal arms
two white pales in the lower part
